correctness.rationale: The unbiased integer stochastic rounding operator gives E[X_n]=u+a^n(X_0-u). For a>=0, {0,1} is invariant and integer states outside drift monotonically toward it almost surely. For a=-r, 0<r<=1/2, deterministic contraction plus subunit rounding error traps all states in S={-1,0,1,2}; transition inspection gives a single closed aperiodic Bernoulli class for b=(1+r)min(u,1-u)>=r and a three-state class otherwise. Solving stationary mass at -1 and mean determines all probabilities; the moment yields variance u(1-u)+2t[r-(1+r)t]/[1-r+(1+r)t]. Direct rational derivative is strictly negative and limiting inflation is (1+r)/(1-r)<=3, with unattained 3 at r=1/2,u->0. Independent exact-fraction stationary and derivative checks corroborate full transition arguments.

limitations: Only scalar exact affine update with one conditionally independent final unbiased integer-grid rounding, not rounded gradients, floating point, or multipliers below -1/2.
